semantic_insights: The evaluated unit is the entire submitted root datasheet, including its file collections, without creating separate component scores or moving nested fields.
The public v3.0.0 release is explicitly distinguished from the separate controlled-access dataset and from future recruitment plans.
Participant totals, demographic group totals and split counts reconcile to 2280.
The nine data-directory file counts plus nine root metadata files reconcile to 356343.
Collection dates precede publication, and the record distinguishes enrollment, formal collection and release coverage.
Standards mapping and modality-specific formats provide substantive interoperability evidence.
Source disagreements and carried-over historical text are generally disclosed instead of silently combined into unsupported current-release claims.
The detailed ethical, access and bias documentation is credited, while remaining gaps are assessed against the comprehensive scoring anchors.
